standard_prerequisites.name: Conditions of the Cohen forcing used for COH and the compatibility relation
standard_prerequisites.statement: A condition is a pair (sigma, rho) with sigma a finite binary string and rho an M-finite approximation of the sequence of sets to be made cohesive, readable as a Mathias condition; a string tau is compatible with (sigma, rho) when sigma is an initial segment of tau and the difference tau minus sigma is contained in the members of the approximation; the article's own account is retained at source lines 480-483.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the condition (sigma,rho) of the counted lemma and the compatibility relation used both to define the set W and to transfer the forcing statement to the generic G.

standard_prerequisites.name: The forcing relation for the existential and universal jump formulas
standard_prerequisites.statement: A condition forces the existential statement that some value of the functional on the generics is defined when a witness and a bound smaller than the length of sigma exist, and it forces the universal statement that all values diverge when every compatible string fails to converge anywhere; the article's own definition is retained at source lines 485-491, and its explanation of forcing a decided initial segment of the jump at source line 505.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma concludes a statement of the form that a condition forces the k-th initial segment of the jump to equal a fixed string, whose meaning is exactly the retained relation at source line 505.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sigma^0_1 definability of the set of candidates and M-finiteness
standard_prerequisites.statement: The set of strings that admit a compatible extension deciding a given pattern is described by a Sigma^0_1(Y) formula, hence is M-finite in a model of RCA_0; the article uses this M-finiteness repeatedly in this section.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof forms the set W of candidate strings, argues that it is Sigma^0_1(Y) and M-finite, and then takes a lexicographically maximal element, which needs M-finiteness.

core_obligations: Form the set W of all strings sigma' of length k for which there are an extension tau of sigma and a bound t such that for every e below k, if tau minus sigma lies in the approximation and has positive length and sigma'(e) equals one, then the functional with index e on sigma plus Y converges at e within t (source line 511).

Observe that W is Sigma^0_1(Y) and hence M-finite, and that W is non-empty because the all-zero string belongs to it; take sigma' in W lexicographically maximal and let tau extending sigma witness that sigma' lies in W (source line 512).
Claim that the pair (tau, rho) forces the k-th initial segment of the jump of G plus Y to be exactly sigma', and prove it by fixing e below k and splitting into the two cases (source lines 514-515).

Case sigma'(e) = 1: from the definition of W, the functional with index e on tau plus Y converges at e, so e belongs to the jump of G plus Y for every generic G compatible with (tau, rho) (source lines 517-517).

Case sigma'(e) = 0: maximality of sigma' rules out any compatible mu for which the functional with index e on mu plus Y converges at e, so the functional diverges on the generic and e is not in the jump (source lines 519-519).
Conclude that both directions hold for every e below k, which is exactly the forcing statement of the counted lemma (source lines 508-509).

proof_roadmap.step: Define the Sigma^0_1(Y) set of candidate strings, note that it is M-finite and non-empty, and take its lexicographically maximal element with a witnessing extension.
State the forcing claim for the chosen string and fix an index below k.
Handle the case where the chosen string already has a one: convergence transfers to every compatible generic.
Handle the case of a zero: maximality prevents convergence on any compatible extension, hence on the generic.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:coh-wf-forcing-jump（源 507-509 行，证明 510-520 行，共 11 行）：任一条件 (sigma,rho) 都有某个 M-有限串 sigma' 属于 2^k 与一个扩展 (tau,rho)，使该扩展强制 (G⊕Y)' 的前 k 位恰为 sigma'。关键操作不是例行核验：作者把「存在相容扩展使某 e<k 处收敛」写成一个 Σ^0_1(Y) 的候选集合 W，用模型的 M-有限性取出字典序最大的 sigma' 与见证扩展 tau（511-512 行），然后按 sigma'(e) 是 1 还是 0 分两类论证——1 的情形由 W 的定义直接得到收敛、0 的情形则必须用 sigma' 的字典序最大性排除任何相容 μ 上的收敛（517、519 行）。难点在于「最大性」这一步把存在性反转为对一切相容扩展的排除，从而使强制关系在泛型上成立；原文位置在证明的 511-512 行与 517-519 行。

editorial_notes: The counted unit is the article's own Lemma lem:coh-wf-forcing-jump at source lines 507-509 together with the proof environment that begins on the next line (510-520); the pairing is the ordinary adjacent one.

The retained context at source lines 480-491 is the author's own account of conditions, compatibility and the two forcing clauses for the jump formulas; the retained context at source line 505 is his own explanation of the relation forcing a decided initial segment of the jump.

The retained preamble reproduces verbatim the author's document class at source line 2, his theorem declarations at source lines 16-25, his macro definitions at source lines 46-88 and 91, his natural-operation macros at source lines 104-107 and his quotation macro at source line 116. The LS2 font-encoding block at source lines 93-99, which declares \smashtimes through the stix fonts, is not retained because the host TeX Live has no stix directory and because the author never uses that symbol: source line 105 defines \ntimes as \dottimes and source line 110 shows the alternative already commented out. mathabx (source line 103) is retained because \dotplus and \dottimes come from it. The cleveref load at source line 6 and the inputenc load with the utf8x option at source line 8 are not retained, for the assembler's own cleveref machinery and the forced xelatex engine respectively. Nothing was renamed, redefined or added.
No retained line contains a citation or a cross-reference, so the material carries no bibliography and needs no navigation pointer.

The article's conservation theorems, its lemma lem:shore-blocking-wf, its lemma lem:wf-product, its lemma lem:coh-wf-forcing-wf and its proposition prop:coh-wf are not counted here and are not used as premises.
